notes.title: 🌳Yggdrasill has a new hope!🌳 (0.2.16)
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34129069/390d67d270e6023bc1f1c9dee8e9eef7d7dff537.gif

The tree of life, 🌳Yggdrasill🌳 has opened the doors to the Neverinth once more and summoned another fearless heroine to its halls. 
She too faces the task of returning the universe to balance and restoring Valhalla to its former glory. 
Along with her trusted katana, she brings a unique set of abilities adding a touch of elegance and poise to Neverinth’s brutal combat. 
In addition, two new weapons (Freeze Bomb and Energy Mead) and three more jewels will be available in her path to the sacred halls reconquest.

Check out all the new updates!
[olist] 
Added：New character – Proud Aspirant 
Added：New weapon Type – Katana 
Added：New skill for the Cultist Mentor boss 
Added：2 New Items 
Added：3 New Jewelry 
Added：1 New Grace 
Added：Customized control settings 
Added：UI prompts will change with different controller/keyboard 
Added：BGM volume control. Sound Effect control  
Added：Motion blur switch 
Added：Japanese localization  
Added：Totem tutorial 
Adjustment：UX adjustment of Totem system (especially with mouse & keyboard) 
Adjustment：Mouse camera control improvements. System- Camera speed ​​unit refinement 
Adjustment：Value adjustment of Bosses – Gram. Cultist Mentor 
Adjustment：Broaden the room of first level (Broaden some part of first level) 
Bug fix：Enemies stop sometimes after we hit them 
 Character control improvements 
[/olist] 
Adjustment of Totem Power 

 
Garm Totem：Attack stamina consumption -70% -> -50%、Life Debt restoration with attack +35% -> +25% 
 
Adjustment of Jewelry ability  

 
Power of Will：When consuming stamina, increase damage % based on current stamina divided by 12 -> 10. 
Earring of Exertion：Damage increases by 1% for every 5 -> 3 stamina points consumed 
Frostbitten Necklace：Shield +180 -> +120. Increases damage taken by 30% -> 35% but freezes the nearby attacker. 
Earring of Adrenaline：Shield +150 -> +70. Physical defense +2 -> +10 
Earring of Proficiency：Shield +400 -> +250  
Earring of Exchange：Shield +280 -> +200. When shielded, every 500 -> 300 Essence possessed by the character will increase damage by 1% 
Alchemist's Ring：Shield +200 -> +150

notes.title: Update 3.0!
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29331634/ba0fe101ca7cffa592c17a9af2bf9881b10f1109.png

Dear Friends and Fans,


Welcome to our incredible update of Original Journey! Whether you’re an old Ato returning to Planet Shadow or a new recruit just joining the invasion we promise you’ll find something to enjoy.

 We’ve added so many new things and improvements over the last few months it’s going to blow your minds! We focused on gameplay complaints mentioned in reviews, replayablility and challenge to create enhance the story driven roguelike action you’ve come to expect from Original Journey.

Here’s a list of all that’s been added:

   
Stunning new character portraits for main cast.
Optimized the game for keyboard and mouse.
5 new elite challenge levels for bosses.
added two special challenge levels "Challenge Caves" and "Monster Frenzy".
All monsters have added super elite varieties.
A special "Energy Currency" has been added for next level upgrades.
New weapon conversion systems have been added.
Weapons can be modified.
Sniper Rifles have been enhanced.
Aiming has been refined making 360 combats more exhilarating.

We cannot wait to hear your feedback.


Yours,


Bonfire Entertainment and Another Indie

notes.title: Update Announcement
notes.content:
Original Journey is finally live. Many thanks to everyone who supported us and left feedback! We’ve listened closely to all your reviews, videos, and comments and we are here with an update made accordingly.

1.	Optimized visual for some of the traps and projectiles 
2.	Adjusted some monster stats
3.	Adjusted Machine Gun stats -, shorter cool down, less recoil
4.	Compatible with more controllers including PS4 controllers
5.	Optimized UI control flow for controllers
6.	New data backup system
9.	Bug fixes

Thanks again for all your support and we will continue to listen.

Another Indie and Bonfire Entertainment
